# PALEOZOIC-MESOZOIC BOUNDARY, BERRY CREEK QUADRANGLE, SIERRA NEVADA, CALIF. (cont.)

have green border zones and include patches of light- green hornblende. Interstitial grains of quartz, which show slight strain shadows but are not granulated, make about 2 percent of the rock. a few grains of chlorite with gray interference color are next to hornblende.

## ALTERED TRONDHJEMITE

A small mass of altered trondhjemite is exposed east of Surcease mine at Big Bend. This rock is coarse grained with clusters of green epidote and chlorite in a light-greenish-gray to white mixture of plagioclase and quartz. Plagioclase (An5) is in large subhedral
